name: Leaderboards
author: BedrockRelay
description: Replaced by Statistics, which counts far more and takes over these totals when you install it. Top tens for playtime, deaths, mobs and players killed, blocks mined and placed, and distance travelled. Offline players stay on the board.
posts: Playtime milestones: when someone reaches 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500 or 1,000 hours.

screenshots.caption: /stats: a player's playtime, kills, blocks and distance, with their rank for each
